in_marathi.name: Darpana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mirror of the mind, Reflector
in_marathi.long_meaning: Darpana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Darpana is a name of the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and learning. The name Darpana means 'mirror' in Sanskrit. Saraswati is often depicted holding a mirror in her four hands, symbolizing the reflective nature of wisdom and learning. A person named Darpana is believed to possess the quality of reflecting wisdom and knowledge, and is a deep thinker and a wise advisor.
